new_destinations.name: Hangzhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: West Lake centre, OSM relation 2308774 (visitor hub of the city)
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a Hangzhou city page whose See section lists West Lake, Lingyin Temple, Leifeng Pagoda, Longjing and Xixi; West Lake is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Hangzhou a headline Chinese destination (Wikipedia/Wikivoyage "Hangzhou").
new_destinations.reason: Rank 2: a national highlight in guidebooks, the Jiangnan city built around West Lake. 42 kept spots, far above the four-spot bar. Span 80 km covers Yuhang, Xiaoshan, Binjiang and the near Fuyang and Lin'an districts.
